messages:
maria: Quick check  exec asked for a single MVP cut today. My call: MVP = chat core + embeddings + SSO stub behind a flag. Defer dashboards, tenant-export, and advanced RBAC to v1.

devon: Agree. SSO stub needs infra & compliance review; mark as medium risk. I'll list blockers in the deps doc.

anya: I'll own the feature-flag gating (pilot whitelist + telemetry + manual enable).

sam: If dashboards are deferred, I'll hide nav items and add an empty-state CTA. Can ship microcopy by EOD.

rafael: Recommend pinning to 13B quant for stable p99. Running perf runs now, will post numbers. Note: quantization may change output nuances.

ops-bot: Reminder: "MVP cut lock" sync tomorrow 09:30 in #all-hands.

maria: Action list: devon = deps/risk; anya = flag+gating; sam = UI copy; rafael = perf. We'll lock final cut at the sync. If anyone objects to deferring dashboards, raise now. :thumbsup:
